title: Array 2D Visible Counts Property Roundtrip

property_write_contract.visible_count_rule: Visible counts are viewport display properties and may exceed the currently materialized semantic shape.
property_write_contract.local_edit_rule: Numeric control edits update front-panel state only until Execute consumes the values.
property_write_contract.design_time_boundary: Immediate IDE live-edit behavior is intentionally out of scope for this execution-mode example.

validation_notes: The Array is a container widget, not a hardcoded numeric grid.
The visible row and visible column properties are written by diagram flow on Execute.
Changing Visible rows or Visible columns without Execute must not resize the Array viewport.
Visible counts may exceed materialized shape without showing a browser validation limit.
Rows must not be clipped for accepted visible counts.
Runtime overlays must align to Default Array and Default Numeric published parts.
No local Example SVG skin is duplicated.
